title: OFTv2 input-side Mirror transform
hypothesis: A shared skew generator plus task addresses can compress multiple exact input-side orthogonal Views; finite Cayley-Neumann truncations trade transform compute for bounded error.
physical_object: One shared 16x16 linear block and skew generator
mirror_coordinate: Six scalar task addresses applied to one shared skew-symmetric S

development.selection_metric: relative output error, actual bytes, transform latency

optimization.method: post-fit least-squares map recovery; no optimizer updates

storage.serializer: uncompressed NumPy NPZ; skew-symmetric matrices stored only as independent lower-triangle values, reconstructed deterministically before fresh access
paid_objects: independent skew matrices or shared S

compute.active_compute_proxy: Q application plus W multiplication; dense materialized baseline separately counted

success_gate: At least 3/4 fresh: shared View relative MSE <=1e-5, <=80% bytes and >=10% lower transform latency than materialized weights.
failure_gate: No byte/runtime Pareto gain over simple scalar-shared-skew control, or K=8 truncation relative error >1e-3.
development_amendment: Development audit found redundant upper-triangle skew storage in native OFTv2 control. All methods now serialize only independent skew coordinates; exact reconstruction is tested. This is a storage implementation correction made before fresh access.
accounting_amendment: After initial fresh metrics were viewed, audit found materialized control was evaluated input-side and Neumann iterations were precomputed outside timing. Preserve v1 as invalid; corrected runtime code evaluates x@(QW) for materialized, executes Neumann recurrence per input, and uses new seeds 149/251/353/457 for corrected audit.
accounting_amendment_2: A second audit found native independent OFTv2 stored repeated S plus amplitudes instead of independent task skew A_t. Preserve v2 metrics, store each task A_t lower-triangle directly, and use new corrected audit seeds 157/263/359/461.
